customManagers.description: Pin of the claude-recall plugin tarball in home/.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl: version and sha256 sit on two adjacent lines and are updated together. The sha256 is taken from the release's checksums.txt. tests/agent-vm/run-templates.sh applies this matchString to the template, so reformatting those two lines fails the tests instead of silently stopping the updates

packageRules.description: Claude Code hook runtime contract. cc-hooks-ts mirrors Claude Code's hook input schema version-for-version (closed valibot enums), so a stale pin makes hooks fail to parse and die before their body runs — SessionStart source=fork did exactly that in 2026-07. Keep these out of the weekly all-non-major group so they land as soon as minimumReleaseAge clears instead of waiting on the slowest package in a 24-dep group. The split relies on packageRules order: repo rules are appended after preset rules, so this groupName overrides the one group:allNonMajor assigns
Auto-merge non-major hook runtime updates. Majors stay manual: cc-hooks-ts v2 required call-site changes, and the agent SDK is consumed directly by hook code

Update every bun pin in one PR. The version is written in three places that different managers read (packageManager in package.json: npm, bun-version of setup-bun: github-actions, the mise config: mise), so without this the pins land in separate PRs and disagree in between

Keep mise cargo: backend versions bare. The preset's rangeStrategy=pin writes cargo range syntax (=1.2.3), which mise rejects as an unsupported semver range; bump updates the bare version in place instead

Hold mise tool updates for 7 days like npm ones (the preset sets minimumReleaseAge for npm only), matching minimum_release_age = "7d" in the mise config. Takes effect only for datasources that report release timestamps

jactionlint is a young linter (2026-10) and a minor release can add default rules that fail CI on unchanged workflows. The preset's :automergeMinor would otherwise merge mise minor/patch bumps on its own, so keep this one for a human to merge after reading the CI result. Must stay after the mise rules above: packageRules later in the list win

claude-recall: Renovate updates the mise version and the plugin external in home/.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl (version and sha256, see customManagers) in this one PR. The 7 day wait is repeated here because the mise rule above is limited to the mise manager, so without it the template dep takes a newer release than mise and the guard in the template fails the PR. The guard stays for the cases where only one of the two lands. Keep it out of the weekly group so a failure blocks only this PR, and off automerge: merging is what accepts the new release
prBodyNotes: The plugin version and sha256 in `home/.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl` were copied by Renovate from the release's `checksums.txt`. Nobody has reviewed what this release contains: merging this PR accepts it. The `agent-vm tests` job checks the sha256 against the downloaded tarball and against `checksums.txt`.
